documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of Postal_Ballot
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Manorama Industries reported a strong Q1 FY27 with a 39.5% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 404 crores and record quarterly milestones. Management highlighted strategic expansions, including a new subsidiary in Chad and land acquisition in Burkina Faso to strengthen the shea sourcing network and backward integration. The company's ongoing capital expenditure program aims to enhance fractionation capacity, solvent fractionation, and refinery operations. Management remains confident in long-term demand and sustainable growth across its specialty fats, butters, and cocoa butter alternative portfolios. Manorama Industries reported strong financial results for Q1 FY27, driven by a 39.5% year-on-year growth in revenue and increased profitability.

guidance.claim: Management expects capacity utilization to be around 80% to 85% for the full year.
guidance.quote: So we expect our to be around 80%, 85% for full year for this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects the payback period for the Burkina Faso plant to be around 3 years once operational.
guidance.quote: So we see a payback period, which should be around 3 years once the plant is operational in Burkina Faso.

guidance.claim: The company aims to maintain all financial parameters going forward.
guidance.quote: The company aims to maintain, all the financial parameters going forward as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted sustained demand across end-use industries and deeper customer relationships.
demand_outlook.quote: Our profitability grew by 67.6% year-on-year, reflecting sustained demand across the end use industries, deeper customer relationships and the increasing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted sustained demand across key end-user industries supported by the growing contribution of value-added specialty fats and butters.
demand_outlook.quote: Profitability increased by 67.6% YoY, reflecting sustained demand across key end-user industries, deeper customer engagement, and the growing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness sustained and growing demand across food and cosmetic sectors worldwide.
demand_outlook.quote: the global relevance of our specialty fats and coco butter equivalents and the sustained and growing demand we continue to witness across the food and cosmetic sectors worldwide through our scientific and high-tech products, which are being used all over the world.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its sourcing footprint in West Africa through the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in Chad.
capex_expansion.quote: We expanded our sourcing footprint in West Africa through the incorporation of Manorama Savannah Agro Chad Sarl in Chad, our wholly owned subsidiary in Chad.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired approximately 10 hectares of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, we acquired approximately 10 hectares, 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility with regulatory approvals currently in the progress.

capex_expansion.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex investment for financial year 2027 is projected to be around INR 225 crores to INR 250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ballpark capex guidance for this year should be around INR 225 crores to INR 250-odd crores of investment in financial year approximately in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The Burkina Faso facility capex is approximately INR 120 crores to INR 130 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So that Burkina Faso facility will be around INR120 crores, INR 130 odd crores approximately, and the balance should be for Indian projects out of INR 460 crores of our proposed capex plan.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure spent until the conference call date was around INR 70 crores out of the total proposed capex plan.
capex_expansion.quote: Until today, we have spent around INR 70 crores out of our total proposed capex plan, and we intend to spend approximately around INR 220 odd crores more in this financial year for our capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans a strategic capital expenditure of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years.
capex_expansion.quote: Through strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years, this investment program spans setting up of a new solvent fractionation manufacturing facility for Sal, Shea, Palm, Mango and other exotic seeds and ESOS.

capex_expansion.claim: The investment program includes setting up a new facility for cocoa butter alternatives and expanding refining capabilities by 200 tons per day.
capex_expansion.quote: Establishment of a new facility for cocoa butter alternatives, expansion of our refining capabilities with additional 200 tons per day refinery, commissioning of raw material processing units in Burkina Faso, West Africa.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax margin expanded by 326 basis points year-on-year to 19.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 67.6% year-on-year, that is INR 79 crores with profit after tax margin expanding by 326 basis points to 19.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost run rate going forward is expected to be around INR 14 crores to INR 15 crores per quarter.
margins_costs.quote: But currently, the run rate, which we can take should be around INR 14 crores to INR 15 crores per quarter going forward. It should be generally in this line only.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin broadly moves in the range of 45% to 50%.
margins_costs.quote: And our gross margin broadly moves in the range of that range only of around 45% to 50%, what we can say because a lot of time, it depends on freight cost timing also and our by-product realization, which is a de-oiled cake.

margins_costs.claim: Stand-alone EBITDA was INR 367.7 crores with a margin of 27.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%, reflecting focused product mix optimization and disciplined cost management.

orders_capacity.claim: A portion of additional fractionation capacity of 7,500 has already been operationalized.
orders_capacity.quote: So we already have done a portion of our additional capacity of 7,500, which is already have been operationalized.

orders_capacity.claim: The balance debottlenecking capacity of 4,500 tons is intended to be implemented around Quarter 3 of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: And the balance is intended to be implemented in a manner during FY27 around Quarter 3 of this financial year, subject to operational time lines.

orders_capacity.claim: With debottlenecking, total plant capacity will increase from 47,500 tons to approximately 52,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: So our current capacity of 47,500 tons will be going to around approximately to around 52,000 tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Fractionation capacity reached 47,500 MTPA as of Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Fractionation Capacity 47,500 MTPA (Includes 25,000 MTPA commercialized in July 2025, plus 7,500 MTPA via debottlenecking in Mar 2026)

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains 30,000 MTPA of finished goods packing capability.
Existing capacity is at a utilization level of 85% of 40,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Existing capacity are on a utilization level of 85% of 40,000 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully completed a qualified institutional placement (QIP).
capital_allocation.quote: The successful completion of our qualified institutional placement, QIP, marks another important milestone, strengthening our balance sheet and providing the financial flexibility to accelerate growth across manufacturing, sourcing and high value-added segments.

capital_allocation.claim: The company holds INR 150-odd crores in fixed deposits (FDR) excluding the QIP component.
capital_allocation.quote: We also have INR 150-odd crores FDR in form of FDR in company with us, excluding the QIP component.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt to equity ratio stood at 0.38:1 as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt and equity ratio is 0.38:1 as of 31st March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores, ROCE of 33.6% and ROE of 40.3%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management acknowledged that business involves risks, but stated that the company has built a robust model.
risks_headwinds.quote: Business is business, business has risk, but Manorama navigates and has built a robust model, and we are looking forward to build it further.

management_commitments.claim: The balance debottlenecking capacity is intended to be implemented around Quarter 3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And the balance is intended to be implemented in a manner during FY27 around Quarter 3 of this financial year, subject to operational time lines.

management_commitments.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are being targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete the capital expenditure program over the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: Through strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years, this investment program spans setting up of a new solvent fractionation manufacturing facility
